pre_run_gates.requirement: The real FusionKernel initial equilibrium must be finite and within the predeclared 0.5 m radial and vertical error thresholds at time zero, or a physically justified initial-condition and disruption contract must be fixed before observing cohort outcomes.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: The schema-v3 wiring assessment records t_disruption_s=0.0 for every completed lane.

pre_run_gates.requirement: NMPC-JAX must load an immutable calibrated dynamics artifact with training-data custody, a disjoint held-out validation split, calibration metrics, domain bounds and an exact artifact SHA-256.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: The current lane is unavailable because the random Xavier dynamics model has no trained artifact or held-out gate.

pre_run_gates.requirement: All seven preregistered lanes must be available; unavailable, failed or omitted lanes make the cohort incomplete.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: NMPC-JAX is unavailable in the schema-v3 wiring assessment.

pre_run_gates.requirement: Every lane must use the same real plant, target, observations, full ordered coil-offset action, actuator dynamics, scenario and per-episode disturbance trace.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: The schema-v3 campaign binds these inputs through one evaluation-contract and campaign-identity digest.

pre_run_gates.requirement: Atomic per-lane checkpoints, exact-seed resume, identity drift rejection, heartbeat metadata and complete traceback custody must remain enabled.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: The schema-v3 recovery contract and focused recovery tests provide this boundary.

pre_run_gates.requirement: Record the exact host and dependencies, use a dedicated unloaded host, declare CPU affinity and frequency-governor state, preserve cold-start separately, and derive reported policy timing from the same successful accuracy cohort.
pre_run_gates.current_evidence: No controlled-host fresh cohort has been run.

pre_run_gates.requirement: Reproduce the frozen cohort identity on a second host; compare scientific metrics separately from host-dependent timing.

analysis_plan.pairing: Compare lanes episode-by-episode using the shared disturbance_trace_digest.
analysis_plan.failure_policy: Retain every failed and unavailable lane; do not impute zero error, zero latency or success.
analysis_plan.promotion_policy: No controller is promoted from latency alone, from a wiring-only surrogate run, or from an incomplete registry.
analysis_plan.reporting: Report point estimates, paired episode-level uncertainty intervals, raw failure counts and the complete predeclared cohort regardless of sign.

execution_authority: Do not run until every pre-run gate is implemented and verified and adequate compute capacity is explicitly assigned.
